_about: Coverage of the plan library on Vancouver candidate lots (zones where a data centre is permitted or conditional: I-2, I-3, I-1C, FC-2), written by Code for the landing page . Every figure is from this run; nothing typed. A lot counts as reached when at least one ADMITTED library plan fits it (at least 3 storeys, every hard gate; the plan inside the lot's buildable box, height and the zone's FAR, at least 30 % of that FAR). Plans that fail a gate are not counted. Lane-as-aisle fits (labelled assumption) are counted separately and are 0 in this round.
